Reflexology

Experience a rejuvenating 30, 45, or 60 minute reflexology session that targets pressure points in your feet to promote deep relaxation and support whole-body balance. Our trained reflexologists use intentional, therapeutic pressure to help relieve tension, improve circulation, and restore a sense of calm — leaving you refreshed, revitalized, and ready to take on the day. Following your session, many clients notice deep relaxation and reduced stress, improved circulation that eases foot and ankle tension, and often better sleep and an elevated mood. Reflexology can also support relief from headaches and tension-related discomfort and serves as a gentle, non-invasive complement to other wellness treatments. Many people report continued benefits—greater ease, calm, and overall vitality—that can last 24–72 hours after their visit.

Deep Tissue Massage

Deep tissue massage targets painful, stiff “trouble spots” using slow, deliberate strokes and firm pressure to reach deeper layers of muscle, fascia, and connective tissue. Ideal for chronic tension, postural stress, and sore areas, this therapy helps release tightness, improve mobility, and restore comfort. Your therapist will tailor pressure to your needs and check in throughout the session.

Mother-To-Be Massage

Prenatal massage is a healthy way to reduce stress, back aches, headaches, leg cramps, and swelling, as well as aiding in better sleep and energy levels. Designed for women who are in their 2nd and 3rd trimester. The therapist uses supportive pillows under the head and under the knees to aid the expecting mother in comfortable positions while performing the massage. The portion of the back will be performed in a side-lying position.
